reference.serial_order: MSB first: each cycle shifts the register up and feeds the new bit in at bit 0, so the bit fed in first ends up at bit width-1

method.harness: both designs instantiated in one testbench and driven by one stimulus, so the primary comparison is against the reference RTL and not against a formula restated in Python
method.protocol: 8 serial bits per operand, MSB first, one bit per enabled rising edge; S is combinational, sampled one time step after the last capture
method.renamed_reference: adder_demo -> adder_demo_ref in a scratch copy, regenerated from upstream, never committed; upstream differs on 1 line

cross_oracle.note: C1 is blind to 29 of the 66 models it negated; this oracle instantiates 3 of them, so 26 models are reached by neither behavioural oracle and rest on the B6 truth tables plus the reading of family names that they encode.

checks.check: the source parses: a shifter, a comparator, and a top that instantiates them
the reference differs from upstream on exactly one line, the module name
the sweep is exhaustive over the whole input space
the reference implements a + b == target on every pair
and asserts on exactly the pairs that equate
our netlist agrees with the reference on every pair
and implements the same function on every pair
our S is not stuck: it is high on the same number of pairs
the equating pairs are a real minority, so the sweep is not trivial
the cross-oracle overlap was computed from C1 s per-model measurement
